typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings to convey a soft, human feel. Use DM Sans for body text for high legibility. Use Caveat sparingly for 'handwritten' emotional notes or signatures.

colors.usage_rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use #2D2A26. Primary color is Peach (#FFBE98) - use for main CTAs. Secondary is Light Blue (#E6F4F1) - use for cards/sections. Background is Warm White (#FAFAF9).

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating cards, modal overlays.

texture.noise: opacity-40 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-[#FFBE98] text-[#2D2A26] font-semibold hover:bg-[#FFAB7D] transition-all hover:scale-105 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-white border border-stone-200 text-[#2D2A26] hover:bg-stone-50 transition-all

cards.project: rounded-3xl bg-white border border-stone-100 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.style: rounded-xl border-stone-200 bg-white/80 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFBE98] focus:border-transparent h-12

layout.alignment: Left-align text for readability. Center-align hero headings for impact. Use asymmetry in image placement.

animations.parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for subtle vertical movement of images.

media.image_style: Warm, dreamy, soft focus, golden hour. Avoid harsh contrast or neon colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #2D2A26 on light backgrounds. Use #6B6661 for secondary text, never lighter.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install 'manrope' and 'dm-sans' via @fontsource or Google Fonts. Configure Tailwind theme with the provided colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_strategy: Use the 'Bento' grid for the project list. Make the hero section immersive with the abstract texture as a subtle background.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'rounded-3xl' and 'warm white' aesthetic. Do not use default sharp edges.

pages.home: Hero with emotional quote + Language selector. Grid of 'Viagens'.
pages.project_detail: Large hero image, progress bar (use accent color), storytelling text, 'Apoiar' button.

universal_guidelines.general: Avoid generic AI designs. Use generous spacing (p-12+). Add micro-interactions to every button.
universal_guidelines.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines.export: Use named exports for components, default exports for pages.
